rule: Seller offer test of 20 (queue block 28, task 6A; site map rules section 1 and decision 3; ODOBRENO PRAVILA - Karlo - 9. 11. 2026 - 6A test). Blends never. `search` is the measured monthly US search for the pair (volume, query, source, checked), null until measured. Read after 12 weeks: passes if at least 16 of 20 are in Google and at least 5 have clicks.
